answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the fable of a task receipt, and the voyage is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit.
